group.passage:
Welcome to Japan, a land where the magic of spring unfolds in a breathtaking symphony of cherry blossoms, renowned as sakura. Close your eyes and envision yourself meandering through tree-lined paths, as delicate petals gracefully descend, greeting you with blushing tones of pink. There are over 200 sakura varieties in Japan, and each one is an extraordinary marvel that demands awe and admiration.
At the forefront of this captivating floral display stands the Somei Yoshino, the most renowned sakura variety that comprises eighty percent of all sakura trees in Japan. Each flower consists of five tiny petals, which is the typical shape of a traditional sakura flower. They start to bloom in early March, only to shed their ephemeral beauty within a fleeting week. The green leaves emerge thereafter, symbolizing nature’s ongoing cycle.
For a more vibrant spectacle, await the arrival of Yaezakura. Unfolding its magnificence a few weeks subsequent to the Somei Yoshino, this variety showcases a true masterpiece of nature, boasting more than six petals per flower, ranging from 10 to 50 in number. These Yaezakura trees, with a lifespan of 300 years, enchant from mid-April to May, offering a captivating sight that leaves an indelible impression.
Immerse yourself in the picturesque beauty of Shidare Zakura, the weeping cherry trees, perfect for those seeking an engaging setting. Adorned with gracefully drooping branches, they evoke a unique aesthetic form, making them the beloved flower of Kyoto Prefecture. From late March to the early days of April, their delicate blooms paint a dreamlike atmosphere, capturing the hearts of all who are fortunate enough to witness this spectacle.
Even if your journey falls within the earlier months of spring, fear not, for the Kawazu-zakura, also known as “winter cherry blossoms,” provide a splendid opportunity to indulge in the beauty of sakura as early as February. Each sakura type possesses a distinct charm and beauty. So, should you find yourself in Japan during springtime, surrender to the enchanting allure of these magical trees, for their ephemeral grace is an experience that will forever linger in your heart.

options.B: Somei Yoshino → Kawazu-zakura → Yaezakura → Shidare Zakura
options.C: Kawazu-zakura → Somei Yoshino → Yaezakura → Shidare Zakura
